claim: The LC/MS result is a mass of 2170.3 Da
locus_A: SI p.4 Fig S1 caption: "LC/MS (m/z) Calc. for C110H203N5O24S6: 2170.31 Da, found: 2170.3 Da" (PDF text layer)
locus_B: SI p.4 Fig S1B, the spectrum itself: labelled ions at 1086.1679 / 1086.6692 / 1087.1695 / 1087.6700 / 1088.1705, spacing 0.5006 Da (read at 900 dpi)
why: The caption calls 2170.3 an (m/z); it is a deconvoluted NEUTRAL mass. The 0.5006 Da isotope spacing fixes z=2, so the observed ion is [M+2H]2+ at m/z 1086.16 and no ion at 2170 was recorded. Chemically harmless, but it is the reason 07_qc.py splits the mass check four ways instead of one: a reader who only checks the caption against our formula never learns that the caption and the instrument disagree about what kind of number 2170.3 is. Back-derived neutral from the drawn label = 2170.3212 Da vs our 2170.3142 (3.2 ppm).

claim: The corpus's stored structure for 6A1-SC8 might be wrong
locus_A: project history: AC_2025 had DLin-MC3-DMA and KC2 carrying each other's structures, invisible to every composition check; the SC6/SC8 swap in 4A3-SC6 is an upstream LNPDB bug in this same KZ_2016 family
why: RETAINED WITH THE MEASUREMENT THAT RETIRED IT, per the brief. q1: the corpus structure's formula is C110H203N5O24S6, identical element-for-element (5/5) to the SI's printed string. q4: its predicted [M+2H]2+ isotope ladder matches 5/5 labels drawn inside the spectrum, worst error 3.23 ppm. An SC6/SC8-style tail swap would move the monoisotopic mass by 12 x 14.0157 = 168.2 Da and could not survive either check. Mass still cannot see connectivity, so this retires the TAIL-LENGTH suspicion only.

claim: The caption's formula string C110H203N5O24S6 could itself be the typo
why: RETAINED WITH ITS MEASUREMENT. The printed string's own monoisotopic mass is 2170.3142 Da, agreeing with the caption's own printed "Calc. 2170.31" to 0.0042 Da, i.e. to rounding. Seeding O24 -> O23 moves that gap to 15.99 Da, so the check has teeth. The string and the printed calc are mutually consistent AND both agree with our structure, which is three independent ways of being right rather than one.

claim: The 16 Fig S2/S3 names might be 16 distinct ionizable lipids
locus_A: the brief's trap 1 ("one paper's '281 lipids' was 564 formulations over 15 distinct lipomers")
locus_B: 01_blocks.csv, built from the PDF text layer
why: RETAINED WITH ITS MEASUREMENT. The names parse as "Base LNP" plus {TAP,DAP,PA} x {10,20,30,40,50}: a 3 x 5 titration grid with a mol-percent suffix, which is a formulation design, not a chemical series. 16 formulations, 1 ionizable structure visible.
